The measurement behind it (runs.jsonl `multiplier-does-not-explain-slot` at eae8d8d): a note reads `slot` rather than `fetch` in the hold census exactly when the derived CMD_SETTEMPO (calls per row) is NOT a multiple of the file's multiplier (Battle_of_Britain 4 % 2 == 0 -> fetch; Food_Feud 8/3 rounded -> slot), so the next note's arrival shifts by a whole frame.
